Synopsis Quattuor Evangeliorum

Import your own Greek text

Paste or load a plain-text file of the Gospels (for example, NA28 exported from your licensed Bible software). One verse per line, beginning with the reference:

Mt 9:9 Καὶ παράγων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον …
Mk 2:13 Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πάλιν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν …
Luke 5:27 …     John 1:1 …     (Mt/Matt/Matthew, Mk/Mark, Lk/Luke, Jn/Joh/John)

The text stays in this browser only. Verses you don’t import fall back to SBLGNT and are marked with a small dagger.

Print or save as PDF

Each section prints on its own landscape page. Choose “Save as PDF” in the print window to make your own bound copy.
